# lazy-component

## Plugin reference

- Description: Pairs React.lazy with its own Suspense boundary so a heavy component is code-split off the eager plugin-boot wave, loading on first mount instead.
- Web:
  - Uses: `primitives/loading.Loading`
  - Exports (types): `LazyComponentOptions`
  - Exports (values):
    - `lazyComponent`
    - `useLazyReady`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/sonata/notation`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-comets`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-core`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-ripples`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-shatter`
    - `map/google`
    - `page/math/render`
    - `primitives/graph-canvas`
    - `primitives/markdown`
    - `primitives/syntax-highlight/code-preview/mermaid`
    - `primitives/text-editor`
- Test helpers:
  - Web: `@plugins/primitives/plugins/lazy-component/web/testing`
    - `loadLazyComponents` — Load every lazy component's chunk declared so far — call it in a suite's `beforeAll`, after the imports that declare them.
